name: Sohemus
description: A shaven-headed envoy, with the look of a Jeskai pilgrim, who translates Dromoka's Draconic and serves 'the Eternal'.

timeline.summary: Daghatar travels to the site of the first battle with Dromoka to meet her emissaries.
timeline.quote: On behalf of the Eternal, we welcome you. I am Sohemus.

timeline.summary: Dromoka lands and grants Daghatar an audience, laughing at his plea for peace.
timeline.quote: That will not be possible. Your tribe of necromancers is a stain on her land that she cannot tolerate.

timeline.summary: Dromoka explains that binding the dead to serve the living is necromancy, which she cannot tolerate, though she respects the Abzan.
timeline.quote: as long as your people are tainted by necromancy, our brood will continue to wipe yours clean from the desert.

relations.note: He translates for Dromoka on behalf of the Eternal.
relations.quote: On behalf of the Eternal, we welcome you.
